en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large wooden building in traditional Scandinavian style with a gabled roof and balcony, set along a dirt road with telegraph poles and surrounded by forested hills. Smaller wooden outbuildings stand nearby. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Trudvang, Rena, and note an establishment run by Marthe Alme. Handwritten cursive text appears across the lower margin and at the upper right corner with a date in July 1905.
